_note: Reasons come from occlusion: each signal is set to its neutral value and the change in the CVE's priority score (mean over 5 seed sets) is measured; the up to 3 largest changes are listed. The score ranks CVEs; it is not a probability of exploitation.

_direction.up: this signal's actual value raises the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value
_direction.down: this signal's actual value lowers the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value

epss.label: EPSS score at the snapshot month
epss.value_meaning: the CVE's EPSS score in its snapshot month (null if EPSS was blank)

direction_meaning.up: this signal's actual value raises the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value
direction_meaning.down: this signal's actual value lowers the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value

public_exploit_code.label: Public exploit code flags
public_exploit_code.value_meaning: number of public exploit flags set in the snapshot month (Exploit-DB, Metasploit, Nuclei, GitHub PoC), 0-4

direction_meaning.up: this signal's actual value raises the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value
direction_meaning.down: this signal's actual value lowers the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value

assigner_kev_history.label: Assigner's KEV history
assigner_kev_history.value_meaning: share of the assigning organisation's earlier CVEs (published 2021+, before the snapshot month) that were added to KEV before the snapshot month, smoothed: KEV count / (CVE count + 20)

direction_meaning.up: this signal's actual value raises the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value
direction_meaning.down: this signal's actual value lowers the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value

description_text.label: Description text score
description_text.value_meaning: text model score (0-1) from the CVE description with exploitation wording masked; a ranking input, not a probability (TF-IDF text model; the Granite text score txt_g is occluded together with it)

direction_meaning.up: this signal's actual value raises the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value
direction_meaning.down: this signal's actual value lowers the CVE's priority score compared with the neutral value
